description.pve: Swapping from this weapon within 10 seconds of killing an enemy grants 35% critical hit chance and 40% critical hit damage for 15 seconds.
After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed (critical) headshot. While the talent is active, killing an enemy will not retrigger the talent.
Swapping to this weapon grants 400% weapon handling for 5 seconds. Kills refresh the buff. Swapping away disables this from all weapons for 5 seconds.
Deal +25% weapon damage to bleeding enemies. After 3 kills, applies bleed to the next enemy you hit.
Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus 70% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10 seconds. Max stack is 2.
+20% Movement Speed. This bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses.
Headshots grant 25% skill damage for 15 seconds.
Killing an enemy repairs 12% armor over 5 seconds. Headshot kills improves the repair to 24%.
Killing a target has a 85% chance to refill the magazine.

Secondary Attribute
+1 Skill Tier when used
Weapon damage is increased by 4% for every 10% ammo missing from the magazine.

description.pve: Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it. While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads you Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied. Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

source: Completion of the Y8S1 Climax Mission (The Pentagon: The Director)

description.pve:
Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% weapon damage increase.

Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapon and will last for 10 seconds.

Editor's note: each stack adds to an amplifier, (1 + 0.2 * n) where n is number of stacks, n from 1 to 10.
Headshot Kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

description.pve:
Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players.

At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor.

Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

Editor's note: the "damage to armor" taken debuff works similarly to Sledgehammer, in that it is an amplifier that applies to both armor and armor plating.
